name: Pads select silently, TRACK + pad plays
description: T1-T6 pads: a plain press only selects the track (no sound). TRACK + pad selects the track and plays the sound. Stock OS: the reverse.
Preset browser open: a plain press still plays (sound preview, stock). TRACK + pad there now selects and plays.
One byte: beq -> bne at 0x4001d374 in PadsView's pad consumer (0x4001d180). No free space used. Generated by tools/gen_invert_track.py. Personal tweak, not part of the upstream project.
